visual_pages_reviewed.finding: The December 2011 release announces changed consumer-goods descriptions for January 2012; Exhibit 7 Semiconductors current/prior are 3438/3503 USD million.
The January 2012 release carries the changed descriptions and Exhibit 7 Semiconductors current/prior 3678/3438 USD million.

The February release explicitly says end-use reclassification was effective with January 2012 statistics and moves smart cards and flash memory cards into semiconductors and related devices. Exhibit 7 current/prior are 3621/3678 USD million; Jan prior equals the preceding Jan report current, but that numeric equality does not remove the December-to-January definition break.

The January 2017 release says several end-use commodity classifications changed effective with January 2017 and will be incorporated into 2014-2016 statistics with the June 2, 2017 release. It does not identify the Semiconductors row as unaffected. Exhibit 7 current/prior are 3829/3865 USD million; the prior equals the preceding December release current, which is not same-basis proof.

same_release_pair_other_months_source_se: All 188 PDFs have one numeric Semiconductors current/prior pair, but the five-page notice scan cannot prove no other unannounced detailed code changes. Same-release pairs avoid cross-release revised-prior mixing; they do not qualify exact first-public bytes or historical availability.
